column1: # ILLUSTRATIVE values to show the format; they are NOT trained on methylation data.
#   BIAS_<context> <float>      # optional per-context intercept (BIAS_CG / BIAS_CHG / BIAS_CHH)
#   <context>  <kmer>  <weight> # context in {CG,CHG,CHH}; kmer length must equal -k and be centered on 'C'
# Probability is computed as: p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(BIAS + BIAS_<context> + weight(context,kmer))))
# Missing terms count as 0, so a k-mer absent from the table scores sigmoid(BIAS + BIAS_<context>).
# Minus-strand k-mers are matched as read 5'->3' on the minus strand (reverse complement).
# --- per-context intercepts: keep the plant ordering CG > CHG > CHH for unlisted k-mers
